analysis.reason: 3거래일 연속 관망 유지. RSI는 50~60 구간에서 방향성 없이 횡보 중. MACD 히스토그램은 음수 구간에서 개선세를 보이나 추세 전환을 확신하기에는 미약한 수준. 거래량도 5일 평균 대비 0.85배로 위축되어 있어 방향성 탐색 구간으로 진단.
analysis.reasonEn: Maintaining a wait-and-see approach for the third consecutive trading day. RSI is consolidating in the 50-60 range without clear direction. MACD histogram shows improvement from negative territory but is weak for confirming a trend reversal. Trading volume is also subdued at 0.85x the 5-day average, indicating a phase of directional exploration.

analysis.narrativeEn:

· Current phase diagnosis (Accumulation phase): awaiting confirmation of $0.19 support and breakout above $0.26 resistance
